# NEWS.md entry, and — since M106 — the interval-methods vignette's MPL

#   key         sha1[:12] of "file\tnormalized claim sentence" (recomputed by
#               the enumerator; a changed sentence must be re-triaged).
#   disposition settle  — the assertion column is evaluated against
#               out     — not settleable by the M92 fixture; reason says why and
#               absent  — the quote is a REGEX that must match nowhere in the
#                         doc scope (AC6 refusal rows); assertion empty.
#   quote       verbatim substring of the claim sentence (whitespace-normalized)
#               that must appear in the doc scope (settle/out), or the forbidden
#   assertion   a Python expression over the parsed fixture: `cell(id, col)`,
# Rows below are seeded from the fixture enumeration (M94 T1); the enumerator's
# cross-check requires every candidate to carry a row and every settle/absent
# row to bind (quote found / regex absent).
